deployment: The dataset ships with BacklotOS and is loaded relative to seedance2_prompt_compiler.py.
format: LoRA-ready JSONL plus deterministic compiler retrieval
hard_rules: Conflicting reference geometry is removed; prose-only negative isolation is insufficient.
A unique story prop has one named owner; every non-owner receives a distinct visible empty-hand action.
Every adjacent keyframe pair declares a physically reachable camera side, position, facing and continuous path before paid generation.
Generated text surfaces stay blank and exact glyphs are added only as real-font AgentCut layers.
Exact dialogue is decoupled from visual prompts so the provider cannot burn native captions into source video.
Three-beat action long takes require at least three ordered state-authority frames with actor, contact and body-relative effect-scale locks.
runtime_behavior: Compilation loads admitted samples and pending defensive rewrites applicable to the requested image or video mode; pending records cannot claim a successful accepted asset.
